svg.title: Check both ends of a mail route
svg.desc: Mail travels between a cloud service and a local server. Success in one direction proves only that trip. Before. Identify the destination the failed route actually selected. Retest. Send a fresh practice message. Confirm the intended destination received it. Control. Send a separate message on the unaffected route. Record that result separately.
svg.text: Check both ends of a mail route
Mail travels between a cloud service and a local server. Success in one
Identify the destination the failed route actually selected.
Send a fresh practice message. Confirm the intended destination received it.
Send a separate message on the unaffected route. Record that result separately.
